name: DubaiVR
summary:
Dubai is one of the most diverse areas in the world, with expatriates making up almost 90% of the total population. It is a hub of business and commerce with over 200 nationalities represented by its residents.

The population boom and expansion of the area is showing no signs of stopping – in fact, with new real estate developments beginning construction regularly, Dubai is a burgeoning city that many are viewing as their potential destinations.
